title: Unit-twist comparison for raw resolution sections
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism, F an O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F, q a natural number, W an open of T and a∈Γ(T,W). Put K=f_*I, P(V)=H^q(K(V)), Y=f⁻¹W and G=F|_Y. There are a global section s of the tensor unit on Y and additive equivalences e_n:P(W)≃H^q(Y,G⊗O_Y^n) such that restriction from W to D(a) agrees with restriction from Y to the nonvanishing locus of s, and the transition induced by s^n carries e_0(x) to e_n(a^n x).

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3, evaluation of f_*I on inverse-image opens; combined with Tag 01E1 restriction of injective resolutions and Tag 09MR tensor-unit numerator maps

proof.text: Apply the untwisted comparison to obtain c:P(W)≃H^q(Y,G), all principal-open restriction comparisons d, and compatibility with the cohomology maps induced by G.smulHom(b^n). The section s is explicitly the pullback b times the unit generator.

Apply the tensor-unit calculation to obtain isomorphisms i_n:G tensor unit^n≅G satisfying ν_(0,n);i_(0+n)=i_0;smulHom(G,b^n). Set e_n to c followed by open cohomology applied to i_n inverse. For a principal open U, set its twisted d to the untwisted d followed by open cohomology on U applied to i_0 inverse.

Naturality of openModuleCohomologyRestriction with respect to i_0 inverse, evaluated at c(x), and the untwisted restriction equation give the required restriction equality. For the transition equality, apply the injective additive equivalence induced by i_(0+n). Functoriality replaces the transition followed by i_(0+n) by i_0 followed by smulHom(b^n). Cancel i_0 inverse followed by i_0; cancel i_(0+n) inverse followed by i_(0+n) on the other side. The remaining equality is the untwisted scalar equation.

proof_origin.place: B2: untwisted resolution comparison followed by proved tensor-unit scalar identity; Lean combines these by cohomology functoriality and restriction naturality

from.place: raw section-complex comparison used in the tensor-unit specialization of the higher-image denominator argument

lean.statement: theorem resolution_unitTwist_comparison {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) (W : T.Opens) (a : Γ(T, W)) : let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F let L := 𝟙_ Y.Modules ∃ (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (e : ∀ n : ℕ, P.obj (op W) ≃+ (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules)), (∀ (U : Y.Opens), (U : Set Y) = nonvanishingLocus L s → ∃ d : P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)) ≃+ (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj (G ⊗ L.tensorPow 0 : Y.Modules), ∀ x : P.obj (op W), (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app (G ⊗ L.tensorPow 0 : Y.Modules) (e 0 x) = d ((P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom x)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : P.obj (op W)), (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).map (mulTensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) G 0 n) (e 0 x) = e (0 + n) (a ^ n • x))
